title: 克苏鲁神秘学装备位不定时更新
content_zh:
，，！
配方：伊本-卡兹之粉3类型：消耗品绿色：30制作需求：消耗20点魔法值，需要材料（黑鸦之羽，墓苔之尘，红磷蛾之翅）提示：可消耗500乐园币补充材料。
效果：挥洒之后，将显化555区域内的所有能量波动。
简介：别名真示显影之尘。
………配方：拉莱耶雾化之瓶类型：消耗品蓝色：70制作需求：消耗50点魔法值，需要材料（水晶瓶、迷雾菇，玄水，落玉草）提示：可消耗3000乐园币补充材料。
效果：对目标区域，释放101010的雾气，感知范围降低20。
简介：以拉莱耶之名，呼唤吾~………配方：支配血清类型：消耗品金色：400制作需求：消耗100点魔法值，需要材料（妖鬼的脊髓液10l，乌泽蛇毒腺1，荧惑晶石50g，迷幻菇10，祖各的胡须一对。
）灵魂结晶（大）1提示：可消耗10000乐园币补充材料。
效果：目标服用后，将对目标的意志力进行一次判定，意志力低于40，将直接成为你的傀儡，并附加‘精神奴役’，持续时间10天。
简介：你可以通过暗示和言语成为他们的主人，并支配和影响他们的行动，只要不危机他们的生命！
……配方：苏莱曼之尘类型：道具紫色：150制作需求：消耗200点魔法值，需要材料（水晶瓶，千年干尸，灵魂结晶（小）1，硝石，乳化剂…）提示：可消耗20000乐园币补充材料。
效果：放逐本位面的生物，对契约者无效。
（体力高于40，造成50生命值伤害，体力高于50，将削弱10属性。
）简介：尘归尘，土归土，退散吧异界之物！
……配方：黄金蜂蜜酒类型：消耗品暗紫色：180~260+（根据酿造的品质判定）制作需求：消耗500点魔法值，需要材料（月亮酒100l、真菌丛林人面蜂的蜜100l、拉波尔之水100l，以及灵魂结晶（中）1）提示：可消耗250000乐园币代替。
效果：使用后，可在真空状态下呼吸，并抵消虚空的压制，让你的属性能得到100发挥，持续时间30~120分钟，提示：搭乘拜亚基、夜魔或夏塔克鸟时的必备产物。
简介：饮用此酒，你的肉体和精神将陷入停滞，若非空间旅行，请勿食用！
……配方：阿尔哈兹莱德之灯1类型：物品金色：400制作需求：需要消耗800点魔法值和150点生命值，并需要材料（伊本卡兹之粉10，拉莱耶雾化瓶5，苏莱曼之尘1，灵魂结晶（中）10或灵魂结晶（大）1）提示：无法通过乐园币消耗补充材料。
耐久：55效果：开启后，可将目标物品、血肉、骨骼或道具投入其中燃烧，并形成一层光幕，你可以借助燃烧的光幕，将目标拉入梦境，冷却时间1个自然日。
提示：每次开启，将消耗1点耐久值，且不可恢复。

提示：燃烧物和目标的亲密度越高，品质越高（最高不能超过传说品质），将目标拉入的时间越长；若目标与你不在同一世界，时间将大幅度缩水。
简介：这是一盏神奇的油灯，他能让你以特殊的方式成为造梦师！
……配方：黑莲入梦药类型：消耗品金色：400制作需求：消耗900点魔法值，需要材料（黄金黑莲3，红磷蛾之翅30，祥和之灵10，梦貘脑干组织30，黄金蜂蜜酒1）提示：可消耗50000乐园币补充部分材料。
效果1：若目标意志力低于50，他将无法感应到周围的事物，并改变自我对周围事物的认知，从而沉睡于在自我的真实梦境之中，持续时间3个自然日。
效果2：若目标意志力高于50，将会渐渐陷入昏睡，并进入‘梦境阶梯’，可选择是否进入‘幻梦境’之中。
持续时间1天，且在脱离幻梦境后，将不会感到精神虚弱。
提示：此效果对意志力高于90的目标，无效。

,,!
Recipe: Ibn-Kazi Powder 3 Type: Consumable Green: 30 Production requirements: Consumes 20 magic points, requires materials (Black Crow Feather, Tomb Moss Dust, Red Phosphorus Moth Wings) Tips: 500 Paradise Coins can be consumed to supplement materials.
Effect: After swaying, all energy fluctuations in the 555 area will be manifested.
Introduction: Also known as the Dust of True Manifestation.
.........Recipe: Raleye Atomization Bottle Type: Consumable Blue: 70 Production requirements: Consumes 50 magic points, requires materials (crystal bottle, mist mushroom, mysterious water, falling jade grass) Tips: 3,000 paradise coins can be consumed to supplement materials.
Effect: Release 101010 fog on the target area, reducing the perception range by 20.
Introduction: In the name of Raleye, call me~... Recipe: Domination Serum Type: Consumable Gold: 400 Production Requirements: Consumes 100 magic points, requires materials (10l of demon ghost's spinal fluid, 1 Wuze snake venom gland, 50g of glowing crystal, 10 psychedelic mushrooms, a pair of Zuge's beards.
) Soul Crystal (Large) 1 Tip: 10,000 Paradise Coins can be consumed to supplement materials.
Effect: After the target takes it, the target's willpower will be judged once. If the target's willpower is lower than 40, it will directly become your puppet, with the addition of 'spiritual slavery', which lasts for 10 days.
Introduction: You can become their master through hints and words, and control and influence their actions, as long as their lives are not endangered!
...Recipe: Dust of Suleiman Type: Prop Purple: 150 Production requirements: Consume 200 magic points, materials required (crystal bottle, thousand-year-old mummy, soul crystal (small) 1, saltpeter, emulsifier...) Tips: 20,000 paradise coins can be consumed to supplement materials.
Effect: Exiles the creatures in this plane, but has no effect on the contractor.
(If the physical strength is higher than 40, it will cause 50 health damage. If the physical strength is higher than 50, the attributes will be weakened by 10.
) Introduction: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust, retreat, alien beings!
...Recipe: Golden Mead Type: Consumables Dark Purple: 180~260+ (determined by the quality of the brew) Production requirements: 500 magic points are consumed, and materials are required (100l of Moon Wine, 100l of Honey from the Fungal Jungle Bee, 100l of La Boer's Water, and Soul Crystal (medium) 1) Tips: 250,000 Paradise Coins can be consumed instead.
Effect: After use, you can breathe in a vacuum state and offset the suppression of the void, allowing you to get 100% of your attributes. The duration is 30 to 120 minutes. Tips: A must-have product when riding a Byakhi, Night Demon or Shattuck Bird.
Introduction: If you drink this wine, your body and spirit will come to a standstill. If you are not traveling through space, please do not consume it!
...Recipe: Alhazred's Lamp 1 Type: Item Gold: 400 Production requirements: It requires 800 magic points and 150 health points, and requires materials (10 powder of Ibn Qazi, 5 atomizer bottles of Raleye, 1 dust of Suleiman, 10 soul crystals (medium) or 1 soul crystal (large)) Tips: Supplementary materials cannot be consumed through paradise coins.
Durability: 55 Effect: After turning it on, target items, flesh, bones or props can be put into it to burn and form a layer of light curtain. You can use the burning light curtain to pull the target into a dream. The cooling time is 1 natural day.
Tip: Each time it is turned on, 1 point of durability will be consumed and cannot be restored.
Tip: The higher the intimacy between the burning object and the target, the higher the quality (the maximum cannot exceed legendary quality), and the longer it will take to pull the target in; if the target is not in the same world as you, the time will be greatly reduced.
Introduction: This is a magical oil lamp that allows you to become a dream maker in a special way!
...Recipe: Black Lotus Dream Potion Type: Consumable Gold: 400 Production requirements: It consumes 900 magic points and requires materialsMaterials (Golden Black Lotus 30, Red Phosphorus Moth Wing 30, Spirit of Peace 10, Dream Tapir Brain Stem Tissue 30, Golden Mead 1) Tips: You can consume 50,000 paradise coins to replenish some materials.
Effect 1: If the target's willpower is lower than 50, he will be unable to sense the things around him and change his perception of the things around him, thus falling into a deep sleep in his real dream for 3 natural days.
Effect 2: If the target's willpower is higher than 50, it will gradually fall into coma and enter the 'Dream Stairway'. You can choose whether to enter the 'Dream Realm'.
It lasts for 1 day, and you will not feel mentally weak after leaving the dreamland.
Tip: This effect is invalid for targets with willpower higher than 90.
